title: The CPU Sorter
briefing: Floor 2: the CPU line! This is where it gets real. Some chips come out of the oven overheated, and those are faulty. Good chips get sorted by speed: fast ones go to GAMING PCs and the rest to OFFICE PCs. Your code decides where each chip goes, and a wrong decision means a customer's PC catches fire. No pressure.
hints: Order matters! Check for overheating FIRST. A chip that's too hot is rejected however fast it is.
Use if / elif / elif / else. Read values from the dict with cpu["temp_c"] and cpu["clock_ghz"]. 'At least 4.0' means >= 4.0.

if cpu["temp_c"] > 90: grade = "REJECT" / elif cpu["clock_ghz"] >= 4.0: grade = "GAMING" / elif cpu["clock_ghz"] >= 2.5: grade = "OFFICE" / else: grade = "REJECT". Then premium = grade == "GAMING" and cpu["temp_c"] < 60
bonus: Rewrite the premium check as a one-line conditional expression: sticker = "⭐" if premium else ""
